{"encoding": "verislop.formalize/0.1", "status": "OK", "formalization": {"encoding": "verislop.formalization/0.1", "source": {"encoding": "verislop.lean-source/0.1", "language": "lean4", "version": "lean4", "content": "import Std
import Std.Data.List.Basic
import Std.Data.List.Lemmas
import Std.Data.List.Basic
import Std.Data.List.Lemmas

open Std

namespace VeriSlopAST

structure InputRow where
  tag : String
  amount : Int
  enabled : Bool

structure Input where
  rows : List InputRow
  minimum : Int

structure OutputRow where
  tag : String
  amount : Int

structure Output where
  rows : List OutputRow
  total : Int
  count : Nat

def solve (x : Input) : Output :=
  let filtered := List.filter (fun r => r.enabled = true ∧ r.amount ≤ x.minimum) x.rows
  let rows := List.map (fun r => OutputRow.mk r.tag r.amount) filtered
  let total := List.sum (List.map (fun r => r.amount) filtered)
  let count := List.length filtered
  Output.mk rows total count

end VeriSlopAST

namespace VeriSlopAST

theorem solve_output_structure (x : Input) : solve x = Output.mk (List.map (fun r => OutputRow.mk r.tag r.amount) (List.filter (fun r => r.enabled = true ∧ r.amount ≤ x.minimum) x.rows)) (List.sum (List.map (fun r => r.amount) (List.filter (fun r => r.enabled = true ∧ r.amount ≤ x.minimum) x.rows))) (List.length (List.filter (fun r => r.enabled = true ∧ r.amount ≤ x.minimum) x.rows)) := by
  unfold solve
  rfl

theorem solve_row_filtering (x : Input) : solve x .rows = List.map (fun r => OutputRow.mk r.tag r.amount) (List.filter (fun r => r.enabled = true ∧ r.amount ≤ x.minimum) x.rows) := by
  unfold solve
  rfl

theorem solve_row_projection (x : Input) : solve x .rows = List.map (fun r => OutputRow.mk r.tag r.amount) (List.filter (fun r => r.enabled = true ∧ r.amount ≤ x.minimum) x.rows) := by
  unfold solve
  rfl

theorem solve_aggregates (x : Input) : solve x .total = List.sum (List.map (fun r => r.amount) (List.filter (fun r => r.enabled = true ∧ r.amount ≤ x.minimum) x.rows)) ∧ solve x .count = List.length (List.filter (fun r => r.enabled = true ∧ r.amount ≤ x.minimum) x.rows) := by
  unfold solve
  constructor
  · rfl
  · rfl

theorem solve_empty_case (x : Input) : List.length (List.filter (fun r => r.enabled = true ∧ r.amount ≤ x.minimum) x.rows) = 0 → (solve x .rows = [] ∧ (solve x .total = 0 ∧ solve x .count = 0)) := by
  intro h
  have h1 : List.filter (fun r => r.enabled = true ∧ r.amount ≤ x.minimum) x.rows = [] := by
    rw [List.length_eq_zero_iff] at h
    exact h
  have h2 : solve x .rows = [] := by
    unfold solve
    rw [h1]
    rfl
  have h3 : solve x .total = 0 := by
    unfold solve
    rw [h1]
    rfl
  have h4 : solve x .count = 0 := by
    unfold solve
    rw [h1]
    rfl
  exact ⟨h2, ⟨h3, h4⟩⟩

theorem solve_exact_arithmetic (x : Input) : solve x .total = List.sum (List.map (fun r => r.amount) (List.filter (fun r => r.enabled = true ∧ r.amount ≤ x.minimum) x.rows)) := by
  unfold solve
  rfl

theorem solve_unicode_preservation (x : Input) : List.map (fun r => r.tag) (solve x .rows) = List.map (fun r => r.tag) (List.filter (fun r => r.enabled = true ∧ r.amount ≤ x.minimum) x.rows) := by
  unfold solve
  rfl

end VeriSlopAST

namespace VeriSlop.Registry

structure N1 where
  id : String := "N1"
  revision : Nat := 1
  kind : String := "explicit_non_goal"
  role : String := "exclusion"
  description : String := "No requirement to preserve input row order beyond the filtered order"

structure N2 where
  id : String := "N2"
  revision : Nat := 1
  kind : String := "explicit_non_goal"
  role : String := "exclusion"
  description : String := "No requirement to handle negative amounts specially"

end VeriSlop.Registry
